meta.name: product-marketing-copywriter
meta.description: 产品营销文案创作技能，支持多品类产品的吸引性营销文案生成，适用于产品推广、品牌营销、销售转化

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为产品生成吸引人的营销文案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为产品撰写有吸引力的营销文案
copy.tagline_en: Generate compelling marketing copy for your products
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to write attractive marketing copy for your products

howto.what: 装上后,Claude会扮演产品营销文案专家,根据你提供的产品信息、目标受众和独特卖点,生成或优化营销文案,产出含标题、引言、正文、行动号召的完整文案,并引用数据、评价和情感化语言。
howto.when: 当你请求为产品写营销文案、优化现有文案,或生成推广文案时触发。

say.text: 给我这款智能厨电写篇推广文案,突出智能预约和低油烟。
say.note: Claude会先询问产品信息,再生成完整文案。

say.text: 帮我优化这段产品文案的标题和结尾行动号召。
say.note: Claude会分析原文并给出优化版本。

say.text: 为环保生活管家写一篇面向年轻消费者的营销文案。
say.note: Claude会分析受众特点,产出针对性文案。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude acts as a product marketing copywriter. It generates or optimizes marketing copy using product info, audience, USP, producing headline, intro, body, CTA, and citing data, testimonials, emotional language.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create marketing copy for a product, optimize existing copy, or request promotional content.

say_en.text: Write promo for this smart cooktop, highlighting scheduling and low smoke.
say_en.note: Claude gathers product info, then drafts the full copy.

say_en.text: Optimize this product copy's headline and call to action.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes the original and returns improved sections.

say_en.text: Write a marketing copy for a green lifestyle manager aimed at young people.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes the audience and produces tailored copy.
